boundary_rationale: Onset: 25:8 opens with the messenger formula and a fresh addressee, "כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְשֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּכָֽל הַגּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.8) — 'Moab and Seir' — with no word-event of its own; this is a messenger-formula addressee-change cut. In the WEB, “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’” (web:Ezek.25.8). Close (both sides): 25:11 ends "וּבְמוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.11), the strict 3mp recognition formula "and they shall know that I am YHWH", with a SAMEKH immediately after. Behind this row, 25:7 closed the Ammon unit on its own 2ms recognition and SAMEKH; ahead, 25:12 opens a fresh messenger formula with a further addressee change to Edom.
boundary_evidence_refs: oshb:Ezek.25.9 (K/Q, single-witness, separators stripped: ketiv וקריתמה / Qere וְקִרְיָתָֽיְמָה)
strongest_rejected_alternative: Merging 25:1-11 (Ammon+Moab) into one row was rejected: the two units close on different recognition-formula forms (2ms at 25:7 versus strict 3mp at 25:11), each with its own SAMEKH, and 25:8-11 is its own oracle_against_nation span distinct from 25:1-7.
device_notes: 25:9 carries a K/Q note (place name, ketiv/qere pair, morpheme separators stripped: ketiv וקריתמה / Qere וְקִרְיָתָֽיְמָה, oshb:Ezek.25.9, K/Q, ketiv/qere); disclosed, not used to argue a boundary. Recognition close at 25:11 is the strict 28-verse 3mp form, cited as such and never blended with the wider 2mp family used at Ezek.25.5.
